nodes.title: Build and document the shared OpenCode V1/V2 adapter
Verify OpenCode V2 lifecycle and conformance

issue.body:
## Objective

Verify OpenCode V2 setup and fail-closed compatibility behavior at the supported floor.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- Verify V2 2.0.4+ with an existing native upstream package, compatible sibling checkout, and absent-upstream stable installation through the active host's documented channel.
- Check authoritative upstream provenance, observable version or revision, required skills, exactly one Backplane installation, gh capabilities, and fresh discovery.
- Exercise unknown/versionless source, duplicate/conflicting install, dirty checkout, path collision, unavailable gh capability, incompatible upstream, and V2 below 2.0.4.

### Out of Scope

- Implement a second OpenCode adapter or undertake OpenCode V1 support work.
- Claim update, rollback, uninstall, or authorized issue-state conformance.
- Alter upstream or issue state during failed preflight.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Each supported upstream mode completes V2 setup and fresh discovery of upstream using-superpowers and both Backplane skills, with separate package identities.
- A V2 release below 2.0.4 reports unsupported without package mutation. Unknown or unobservable provenance remains UNKNOWN.
- Each failure names the failed check and recovery action and preserves existing user files, unrelated plugins, upstream installation, and GitHub issue state.

## Verification Seams

- Record V2 host version, Backplane revision, upstream source/version/commit, gh auth and native intake/label/closure-reason capability, three installed skill identities, and PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN for every mode and failure probe.
- Replay the V2 setup guide in disposable profiles and capture fresh-session discovery.
- Compare native configuration, plugin entries, files, upstream identity, and issue state before and after failure probes.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Functional design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-v0.1-adoption-installation-contract-design.md (approved 2026-09-19).
Rescope design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-host-installation-leaf-rescoping-design.md.
Approved [V2 setup plan](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/6362be0da9ad9f0eba8889b94bf1047671156f88/docs/superpowers-backplane/plans/2026-11-01-issue-23-opencode-v2-setup.md) and [approval receipt](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/6362be0da9ad9f0eba8889b94bf1047671156f88/docs/superpowers-backplane/plans/2026-11-01-opencode-wrap-approval.json). The plan consumes issue revision `2026-09-20T01:30:21Z`. The V2-only decision in #12 leaves the V2 acceptance criteria and verification seams intact. Apply the V2 setup and shared preservation checks from the approved plan; exclude V1 qualification and V1-specific guide work. Preserve unrelated behavior and existing files during V2 verification.

argv: Set up Backplane in OpenCode V2. Verify that this host is supported, that exactly one Backplane package is effective, and that upstream Superpowers is independent and has known provenance and a visible version or revision. Use the existing native package or compatible sibling checkout when available. If upstream is absent, follow its documented V2 stable installation channel and preserve unrelated configuration. Run gh auth status and read tvproductions/superpowers-backplane#23 using the complete native intake from the Backplane issue contract. Check the gh issue edit label flags and gh issue close reason flag through help. Report the host version, package sources and revisions, and which checks passed, failed, or remain unknown. For a failure, identify the failed check and recovery action. Preserve user files, unrelated plugins, existing upstream and GitHub issue state. Stop after setup and these read-only checks.

Use the native skill tool to load using-superpowers, managing-superpowers-backlog, and managing-superpowers-handoffs. Report each tool result and its source path. Do not query GitHub, mutate any issue or file, run setup, or delegate. Stop after reporting discovery.
